title: Grateful Dead Live at University Of Iowa Fieldhouse on 1982-08-10

ai_review.summary: An outstanding matrix blend captures a high‑energy ’82 show highlighted by a smoking “Roses” and tight band playing.
ai_review.review: The matrix recording delivers crystal‑clear, almost surround‑sound detail that lets listeners feel right on the stage, with particular praise for the superb rendition of "Roses." The performance is described as tight and fiery – an 80‑minute first set packed with upbeat tunes, a standout China > The Rider sequence, and a rocking Sugar Magnolia finale – though one reviewer notes the set felt a bit sloppy overall.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give five‑star praise for both sound quality and musical performance; only one mentions sloppiness, resulting in a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix blending of board and audience provides exceptional clarity and depth, described as "surround sound"; minor channel glitches are noted but do not detract from the overall crispness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, upbeat first set with a killer opener and smoking closer; second set features an extended China>Rider and high‑tempo jams leading to a powerful finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as extremely on, hitting every note with crisp, clear vocals and superb guitar tone.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for dropping huge bass bombs during the show.
